title: Flowing in Excellence: Moving Beyond Imperfection
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the secret to unlocking God's blessing in your life: operating in excellence. By examining your heart and motives, you'll learn how to move from a spirit of complaining to a spirit of obedience, teachability, and generosity, just like the people God used throughout the Bible. Don't miss this timely message that will challenge you to re-examine your priorities and invite God's favor into every area of your life.
